title: Agent work-item lock
description: One active claim: a work-item held by an agent in an isolated worktree. Lives on the MAIN checkout (git-ignored), never inside the worktree, so teardown can't orphan it. Validate locks against this schema at claim time — do not leave it doc-only.

item.description: work-item id, e.g. ITEM-123 — adjust the pattern to your id scheme

phase.description: CLOSED ENUM — replace with your project's phase vocabulary, but keep it a closed set synchronized with the overlap engine's execution-phase filter; a free string here means a typo'd phase silently escapes every phase-filtered safety gate

expiresAt.description: startedAt + ttlHours (default 24h). Locks EXPIRE, they don't refresh; nothing reaps them automatically.

branch.description: feat/<item>-<slug> (pattern is stricter than strictly required — deliberate)

ownedPaths.description: glob array mirrored from the spec's Conflict Surface; the overlap engine materializes these against git ls-files

touchedFiles.description: OPTIONAL vestige of a pre-ownedPaths design — typically auto-seeded with only the spec doc path; its pairwise-overlap check catches just two-claims-on-one-spec. Keep or drop.
